conflicts.remarks_quote:
A part with bend information is being edited in context of the assembly (see [[IAssemblyDoc::EditPart2]])

The bend state for that part is returned.

This method is run on a part without bend information or directly on an assembly

swSMBendStateNone is returned, and the return status is S_false (COM only).
conflicts.example_quote:
nBendState = swModel.GetBendState
    Debug.Print "File = " & swModel.GetPathName
    Debug.Print " Original bend state = " & nBendState
    If nBendState <> swSMBendStateFlattened Then
conflicts.why: Remarks 只列了「在装配体上下文编辑」与「无折弯信息或直接在装配体上」两种情形；示例的前置是直接打开钣金件，两种都不覆盖，却按能取到真实弯折状态使用。

example_more_specific.what: 示例还要求改完 bend state 后调用 EditRebuild3 才能看到变化
example_more_specific.example_quote:
' Rebuild to see changes
        bRet = swModel.EditRebuild3: Debug.Assert bRet

results.note: Remarks 是二选一的 If/Then 表，未列「直接打开的钣金件」这一情形。

    If (count < 1) Then
        MsgBox ("There are no bodies. Create a body in the folder.")
    Else
        bodyList = swBodyFolder.GetBodies
    End If
